description: Spike: flag-selected headless implementer worker via `claude --print` stream-json, coexisting with the tmux path. PRD-LEVEL DELIVERABLE GAP (declared, not deferred silently): after all eight stories are green the suite proves this path only against a fixture executable standing in for `claude`, so two things stay UNPROVEN and are handed back to the operator as a ceremony to file via /cam-issue on main, (a) one real `claude --print --input-format stream-json --output-format stream-json --verbose` dispatch of a real story through this seam, and (b) the before/after Anthropic console metering that the issue names as the ORACULO CENTRAL of billing. Nothing in this PRD may be read as satisfying that central oracle.

officialDocsConsulted.version: 2.1.226 (observed locally via `claude --version` on 2026-08-09; the 2026-08-08 billing measurement recorded in ADR-0059 does not record its own build string, so this is the nearest pinned observation and the implementer must re-observe before trusting any version-gated behavior below)
officialDocsConsulted.summary: Confirms the flag set this PRD builds: `-p/--print`, `--output-format stream-json` (newline-delimited JSON, last line is a `result` message carrying cost and session metadata), `--verbose`. Confirms GOTCHA H: token-level `stream_event` deltas are emitted only under `--include-partial-messages`, which this PRD deliberately does not pass, so `stream_event` must be handled by an explicit named branch rather than by omission. Confirms SIGTERM aborts the in-progress turn, terminates the Bash process tree, runs SessionEnd hooks and exits 143, which is the contract the idle-budget kill in US-003 relies on. Several behaviors are gated on specific builds (v2.1.163 background-task grace, v2.1.182 background-agent wait cap, v2.1.205 `capabilities` array, v2.1.211/219 subagent and MCP-error fields, v2.1.214 drain cap), so the version pin above is load-bearing.
officialDocsConsulted.localConventionConflict: The page recommends `--bare` as the mode for scripted/SDK calls and says it will become the default for `-p`, but `--bare` explicitly never reads OAuth credentials or the system keychain and expects ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, which is the exact opposite of this repo's subscription-only invariant and of the host + config-dir credential ADR-0059 actually measured; the headless path must therefore NOT pass `--bare`, and US-001 must record that refusal next to the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY strip.

officialDocsConsulted.summary: Confirms the spawn shape US-003 needs: `terminal` is the ONLY option that attaches a PTY, so simply omitting it yields a non-TTY child (and when `terminal` IS passed, `proc.stdin/stdout/stderr` all return null, which is exactly the failure mode GOTCHA F warns about). `stdin: 'pipe'` returns a FileSink with incremental `write`/`flush`/`end`, which is how the bidirectional stream-json input message is delivered. `stdout` defaults to a ReadableStream, `proc.exited` is a Promise<number>, `env` is a plain record, and `timeout` + `killSignal` (SIGTERM by default) give the idle/timeout kill without hand-rolling a timer race.

[oracle: bash -c 'grep -q "gship next --headless" scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md'] [species: change-detection; RED-ON-MAIN @3afb0913 2026-08-09 EXIT=1, no match]

`test/docs/recorte-fidelity.test.ts` checks FIDELITY, not token presence: every measured claim the recorte paragraph asserts (the 2026-08-08 date, the unchanged console consumption, the reported apiKeySource, the rate_limit_event with its seven-day subscription window, and the host + config-dir scope of the measurement) must also be present in `docs/adr/0059-execucao-headless-do-worker-a-proibicao-de-2026-06-e-recortada-nao-aposentada.md`, and the paragraph must NOT assert a measurement the ADR explicitly records as unmeasured (the container + env-token combination). [oracle: bun test ./test/docs/recorte-fidelity.test.ts] [species: change-detection; RED-ON-MAIN @3afb0913 2026-08-09 EXIT=1, test file absent]

The fidelity checker is swept red against a fabricated copy INSIDE the test itself: the test materializes a tmpdir variant of the paragraph whose measured justification is replaced by plausible invented prose, and asserts the same checker rejects it (issue AC7 requires this sweep before the criterion counts as satisfied). Test named `fabricated`. [oracle: bun test ./test/docs/recorte-fidelity.test.ts -t "fabricated"] [species: change-detection; RED-ON-MAIN @3afb0913 2026-08-09 EXIT=1, test file absent; a zero-match `-t` filter also exits 1 (measured 2026-08-09)]

The seventh anchor point named by GOTCHA L is addressed: the prohibition comment in `src/commands/run-auth-preflight.ts` (around line 72) is updated to say the prohibition is recortada, naming the headless exemption instead of reading as a blanket ban. [oracle: bash -c 'grep -q headless src/commands/run-auth-preflight.ts'] [species: change-detection; RED-ON-MAIN @3afb0913 2026-08-09 EXIT=1, no match]

The five test files that anchor the prohibition stay green with no assertion removed or weakened (issue AC6). [oracle: bun test ./test/supervisor/loop.test.ts ./test/supervisor/worker-argv.test.ts ./test/supervisor/review.test.ts ./test/supervisor/plan/plan-argv.test.ts ./test/supervisor/docker-exec.test.ts] [species: invariance pin; GREEN on main @3afb0913 2026-08-09 EXIT=0, 322 tests]

Full quality spine passes (bun run check:all), including the vendor-drift gate for any `templates/` mirror edit (issue AC8). [oracle: bun run check:all] [species: invariance pin; GREEN on main @3afb0913 2026-08-09 EXIT=0, measured]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck] [species: invariance pin; GREEN on main @3afb0913 2026-08-09 EXIT=0]
Tests pass (bun test). [oracle: bun test] [species: invariance pin; GREEN on main @3afb0913 2026-08-09 EXIT=0, measured inside `bun run check:all`]
userStories.notes: GOTCHA L lists seven anchor points: the five test files (left untouched and green, criterion 5), the declaration in `scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md` (line 91 currently names `claude -p forbidden` among the durable invariants that must never be marked resolved, so the recorte prose has to sit with it, not contradict it from elsewhere), and the comment in `src/commands/run-auth-preflight.ts:72`. `templates/scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md` is the distributed mirror: diff it first (memory: cam dual-copy is per-file, the copies are NOT uniformly byte-identical) and if it changes, run `bun run embed-vendor` then `embed-vendor:check`. Also append a `scripts/cam/patterns.md` bullet for the headless path per the knowledge-layer routing table. `test/docs/` does not exist yet: create it. Do not write a new ADR; ADR-0059 and ADR-0060 already carry this decision and the doc-maintenance rule is to cite them, not restate them. Keep the persisted prose free of em dashes per the repo's writing convention.
